faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to common questions about QR Code Digital Card and digital cards.
faq.q1: Do recipients need an app to view my card?
faq.a1: No! No app or download is required. Anyone can point their smartphone camera at your QR code and instantly view your full card.
faq.q2: What happens if I update my phone number or job title?
faq.a2: Your QR code and URL stay exactly the same. When you update your info in the editor, all future scans automatically display the updated details.
faq.a3: The 'Save to Contacts' button triggers a standard .vcf 3.0 download that seamlessly integrates with iOS Apple Contacts and Android Google Contacts.
faq.q4: Can I print the QR code on physical cards or badges?
faq.a4: Yes! You can export your card as a 3x high-resolution PNG or download the QR code for printing on banners, flyers, or encoding to NFC tags.
